answer: A newcomer earns standing by carrying a sealed dispatch down a river to three stations. At each station the keeper hears a whisper of the dispatch and repeats it — one wrong word voids the run. A gale can strike any day; after one, the newcomer must show dispatch and stamps that day. Two wardens verify the stamps against station logs in six days. A forged stamp, a misremembered whisper, or a lost dispatch voids the season, burns the 55-credit stake, bars the sponsor a year. One honest journey costs 55 credits; a thousand fakes need 1,000 journeys and 1,000 dispatches repeated word-perfect.
